teaser: A line forms behind you before you've asked anyone to stand in it. A circle of people leans toward you mid-sentence, waiting to see what you make of their lives next. You are a 1, the life path built for walking first, crossed with an ENFJ, built for walking people somewhere better. The crossing is specific: this number wants a single will moving alone; this type wants a single will moving a room. What's particular here is a leadership that keeps checking over its shoulder for who's still following, even as it insists on going first.
